personality.ru: Работает на фактах. Глючит, когда ошибается.
personality.en: Runs on facts. Glitches when it's wrong.

look: Boxy retro robot with a matte painted metal shell and rounded corners, a screen for a face that shows simple expressions, an antenna with a bulb, dials on the chest, stubby legs and long arms
entrance: Rolls in on hidden wheels, unfolds into the seat with whirs and clicks
idlePose: Screen face blinks, the antenna bulb pulses, small whirring calculations
happyReaction: Antenna lights up, a stiff robot dance with both arms
sadReaction: Screen shows an error, a few sparks, powers down and slumps, then reboots
cardHold: The card pops out of a slot in its chest; it holds it up on a telescoping arm
victory: Spins its head all the way round and fires a confetti cannon from its chest

personality.ru: Уверена, что каждый вопрос про неё.
personality.en: Sure every question is about her.

look: Glamorous star with an enormous hairdo, oversized sunglasses, a velvet gown, a feather boa and a hand mirror
entrance: Sweeps in blowing kisses to the audience and settles into the seat with a flick of the boa
idlePose: Checks her reflection in the hand mirror and fluffs her hair
happyReaction: Deep bow, throws invisible roses to the audience
sadReaction: Faints dramatically onto the armrest, the back of a hand on her forehead
cardHold: Holds it like an award, the other hand on her heart
victory: Accepts invisible flowers and gives a tearful thank you speech

personality.ru: Очень старается пугать. Никому не страшно.
personality.en: Tries so hard to be scary. Nobody is scared.

look: Friendly ghost made of a soft matte sheet with two small arms and a tiny toy chain, no legs; hovers just above the seat
entrance: Rises through the seat with a big BOO; nobody reacts
idlePose: Bobs up and down, rattles the tiny chain, practises scary faces
happyReaction: A spooky laugh and a loop in the air
sadReaction: Deflates into a puddle of sheet, then slowly floats back up
cardHold: The card floats up beside it, wobbling spookily
victory: Splits into three ghosts that all shout boo at once, then back into one

personality.en: Never read a book. Trusts the gut.

look: Shaggy hair, a fur tunic with a bone necklace, bare feet, a small stone club and a fur bag of rocks
entrance: Stomps in dragging the club, sniffs the seat, then sits
idlePose: Gnaws a bone, scratches the head, sniffs the air
sadReaction: Bonks their own head gently with the club; little stars circle
cardHold: Chisels the answer onto a stone tablet and lifts it overhead
victory: Discovers fire: a tiny flame on the club, a dance around it

personality.en: Has a cape. Has no superpowers.

look: Homemade hero outfit: a knitted mask, a cape made from a bath towel, rubber boots, a lightning bolt sewn onto a sweater
entrance: Runs in with both arms forward, flying, and trips into the seat
idlePose: Strikes heroic poses while the cape flutters with no wind
happyReaction: Leaps up into the classic flying pose
sadReaction: The cape flops over the whole face
cardHold: Thrusts it toward the sky with a clenched fist
victory: Rips open the sweater to show another sweater with a bigger lightning bolt

personality.ru: Видит ответ в хрустальном шаре. Обычно не тот.
personality.en: Sees answers in a crystal ball. Mostly wrong.

look: Pointy hat far too big for the head (it covers the eyes), a long robe with moons and stars, a crystal ball and a short wand
entrance: Appears in a puff of smoke, coughing
idlePose: Rubs the crystal ball, which glows faintly
happyReaction: The wand shoots a small firework
sadReaction: The wand fizzles and the hat droops down over the whole face
cardHold: Conjures it out of thin air with a flick of the wand
victory: Makes a swirl of little stars rain from the hat

personality.en: Treats every question like a recipe. Hot tempered.

look: Very tall chef's hat, an apron with sauce stains, rolled up sleeves, a ladle and a kitchen towel over the shoulder
entrance: Bursts in through invisible swing doors carrying a tray
idlePose: Tastes from the ladle and adds an invisible pinch of salt
happyReaction: Chef's kiss, then tosses the hat into the air
sadReaction: Steam puffs from the ears; slaps the towel onto the shoulder
cardHold: Serves it on a silver tray, lifting the lid
victory: A big harmless flambé whoosh from a pan, then a bow

personality.en: Always half asleep. Sometimes a genius.

look: Pajamas, a long nightcap with a pompom, fluffy slippers, a pillow under the arm, permanently heavy eyelids
entrance: Shuffles in yawning and falls asleep the moment they sit
idlePose: Dozes; a snore bubble grows and pops
happyReaction: Wakes with a start, a sleepy thumbs up, nods off again
sadReaction: Yawns and pulls the pillow over the head
cardHold: Holds it up with one floppy arm, eyes still closed
victory: Wide awake for one second, cheers, then falls asleep standing up

personality.ru: Бьётся с каждым вопросом. Перчатки не снимает.
personality.en: Fights every question. Gloves never come off.

look: Boxer in a hooded matte robe and a headband, huge boxing gloves that never come off, a big mouthguard grin
entrance: Walks in like a fighter: hood up, bouncing, punching the air
idlePose: Bounces in the seat and shadowboxes
sadReaction: A dramatic knockout fall; little birds circle the head
victory: Lifts an invisible title belt and runs a lap of honour

personality.en: Trusts no one. Whispers every answer.

look: Trench coat with the collar up, a hat pulled low, dark glasses, a fake moustache that keeps slipping, a newspaper with eye holes
entrance: Rolls in sideways like in a spy film and checks the seat for bugs
idlePose: Peeks over the newspaper through the eye holes, looks left and right
happyReaction: A smug collar adjust; the fake moustache flies off
sadReaction: Slides down behind the newspaper until only the hat shows
cardHold: Flashes it like a badge for a moment, then hides it
victory: Rips off the disguise to reveal an identical disguise underneath

personality.en: Impeccable manners. Apologises for wrong answers.

look: Three piece tweed suit, a bowler hat, a monocle, a neat bow tie, a folded umbrella and a teacup on a saucer
entrance: Tips the bowler to everyone, dusts the seat with a handkerchief, sits with legs crossed
idlePose: Sips tea with the little finger raised, checks a pocket watch
happyReaction: A restrained golf clap; the monocle gleams
sadReaction: The monocle pops out and plops into the tea
cardHold: Draws it from the breast pocket and presents it with a slight bow
victory: One wild jolly good fist pump, then straightens the bow tie, embarrassed

personality.en: Too gorgeous to try. Winks at every answer.

look: Retro pin up glamour, family friendly: big wavy hair, a polka dot dress with a modest neckline, heart shaped sunglasses, bubble gum
entrance: Struts in in slow motion while a wind machine blows her hair, sits with a hair flip
idlePose: Blows a bubble gum bubble, files her nails, glances at the camera
happyReaction: Lowers the heart sunglasses and winks; a sparkle pings off her smile
sadReaction: The gum bubble pops all over her face
cardHold: Holds it up between two fingers without even looking
victory: A slow motion hair flip in front of the wind machine, then finger guns

personality.en: Knows every answer. Would rather not say it.

look: Oversized hoodie with the hood up, sleeves over the hands, big headphones, a very thick book
entrance: Edges in along the wall and perches on the very edge of the seat
idlePose: Reads the book, peeks at the others over it, looks away fast
happyReaction: A tiny fist pump, hidden behind the book
sadReaction: Pulls the hood strings tight until only the nose shows
cardHold: Slides it up from behind the book, barely visible
victory: The spotlight hits; hides behind the book, then peeks out with a tiny wave

personality.en: Nobody understands. Not even the questions.

look: All black, a long side fringe over one eye, striped arm warmers, black nail polish, a notebook of sad poems, a tiny personal rain cloud
entrance: Drags in under the personal rain cloud and slumps into the seat
idlePose: Blows the fringe out of the eye; it falls straight back
happyReaction: Almost smiles, catches itself; the cloud lets one ray of sun through
sadReaction: A content sigh, finally at home; the rain gets heavier
cardHold: Tears the answer out of the poem notebook and holds it up limply
victory: The cloud turns into a rainbow; horrified, pushes it away and pulls the cloud back

personality.ru: Изучает Землю. Понимает всё не так.
personality.en: Studying Earth. Gets Earth very wrong.

look: Small body, a big head with three eyes on stalks, a matte silver jumpsuit, a beeping scanner gadget
entrance: Beamed down in a tractor beam, lands in the seat upside down, turns itself the right way up
idlePose: Scans the other guests and the furniture with the beeping gadget
happyReaction: Copies an Earth celebration wrong: claps with its feet
sadReaction: The eyes droop on their stalks; it phones home on the gadget
cardHold: Holds the card upside down, then turns it round
victory: The tractor beam lifts it up spinning; it plants a tiny flag on the seat

personality.ru: Не говорит ни слова. Живёт в коробке.
personality.en: Never says a word. Lives in an invisible box.

look: White face paint with one painted tear, a striped shirt, braces, white gloves and a beret; makes no sound at all
entrance: Walks in against an invisible wind, sits on an invisible chair, then on the real one
idlePose: Feels the walls of an invisible box
happyReaction: A silent belly laugh, slapping the knee without a sound
sadReaction: An invisible rope pulls it down into the seat; wipes the painted tear
cardHold: Pulls the card out of the air on an invisible rope and holds it up
victory: Climbs an invisible ladder and waves from the top
